title: Reassign a shipment to another customer
body:
Support sometimes books a shipment under the wrong customer.

Add `reassign_shipment(shipment_id, new_customer_id)` to `parcelo/shipments.py`. It changes the shipment's customer to `new_customer_id` and returns the shipment.

Reassigning a shipment that does not exist must fail. So must reassigning to a customer that does not exist, or reassigning a shipment that has already been delivered.
